title: UMG Bundle Schema
description: Reusable cognitive units that expand into NeoBlocks or NeoStacks. Eliminates repeated governance blocks. v0.2 supports inline expansion and ID-only deduplication. referenced and inherited expansion modes are reserved for Phase 3.

BundleMember.description: A member block within a bundle.

block_id.description: ID of the block from the canonical registry or session-defined blocks.

block_name.description: Human-readable name. Populated by resolver from registry.

molt_type.description: MOLT type of this block. Populated by resolver from registry.

authority_rank.description: MOLT authority rank. Populated by resolver.

override_name.description: Optional local name override for this bundle instance. Does not change block_id.

required.description: If true, bundle expansion fails if this block cannot be resolved. If false, block is skipped with a warning.

Bundle.description: A named reusable collection of MOLT blocks.

bundle_id.description: Unique identifier. Convention: BUNDLE_{DESCRIPTOR} in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

bundle_type.description: same_type: all members share one MOLT type. chain: vertical chain across MOLT types. capability: functional module with multiple block types. governance: reusable governance core. route: gate + stack + block routing packet.

name.description: Human-readable bundle name. Examples: Sovereign Governance Core, Transparent Reasoning Module.

description.description: What this bundle provides when expanded.

members.description: Ordered list of blocks in this bundle. Order matters for chain bundles — authority rank order is enforced on expansion.

molt_scope.description: MOLT types present in this bundle. Populated by resolver from member blocks.

expansion_mode.description: inline: member blocks are copied into the target NeoBlock on expansion (v0.2 supported). referenced: bundle is referred to by ID without copying (Phase 3). inherited: parent sleeves define bundles that child sleeves inherit (Phase 3).

merge_policy.description: How to handle member blocks that overlap with existing blocks at expansion target.

override_policy.description: locked: no local modification allowed. local_override: members can be overridden by the receiving NeoBlock. extend_only: additional blocks can be added but bundle members cannot be removed.

dedup_strategy.description: How duplicate detection works on expansion. v0.2: id_only — a block_id already present at the expansion target is skipped. Semantic deduplication is not implemented in v0.2.

rank.description: Bundle priority when multiple bundles expand into the same NeoBlock. Higher rank = applied first.

requires_sovereign_review.description: If true, bundle must not enter active runtime without MAG review.

tags.description: Optional classification tags. Examples: governance, transparency, escalation.

BundleExpansionResult.description: Output of bundle expansion for a single bundle. Appended to RuntimeSpec.bundle_expansions and route_trace.

target_neoblock_id.description: ID of the NeoBlock that received the expansion.

members_attempted.description: All block IDs that were attempted for expansion.

members_added.description: Block IDs successfully added to the target NeoBlock.

members_deduped.description: Block IDs skipped because the same ID was already present at the expansion target. ID-only dedup. No semantic evaluation.

members_suppressed.description: Block IDs not added due to merge_policy or override_policy rules.

members_failed.description: Block IDs that could not be resolved. Expansion fails if any required member fails.

provenance.description: Records that these blocks originated from a bundle, not direct NeoBlock authoring.

description: Bundle definition object for use in sleeve JSON or bundle registry.

seededBundles.name: Sovereign Governance Core
seededBundles.description: Standard governance foundation block set. Provides Honor Governance + Be Transparent + Escalate When Needed + Protect Governance. Replaces repeated inline governance blocks across stacks.

seededBundles.name: Transparent Reasoning Chain
seededBundles.description: Full transparent reasoning chain: directive + instruction + primary + persona. Provides the behavioral foundation for honest, explicit analytical output.
